body.statement: For a fixed sufficiently regular source law and a spatially regular \(C^1\) path of positive target densities, the corresponding optimal-transport maps form a \(C^1\) path in a H\"older topology, and the path derivative is the uniquely normalized solution of the linearized Monge--Amp\`ere equation.

source.verbatim_statement: then the curve \(\{\nabla\phi_t\}_{t\in I}\subset\mathcal C^{1,\alpha}(\overline{\Omega})\) is also \(\mathcal C^1\).

attestation.note: Transcribed from Theorem 3.2; the locator contains the derivative equation and its normalization.
